notes.source C3: This is a fictional training debrief for the Kandor Rural Roads project, Package one. I visited the site from the 10th to the 14th of November, 2026, at kilometer 18. I measured the road width at 4.9 meters. The specification is 7 meters, so the road is too narrow at that point. I have a photo and a tape measurement. Candor Roadworks Limited Reports 32 of 64 kilometers of asphalt build, out of 64 kilometers in total, which is half of the road. The section 3 bridge is not started. The contractor gave reins and fuel shortages is the reason. Invoice 14 asks for $480,000. With this invoice, payments reach $8.5 million, which is 85% of the contract value, physical progress is only 50%, so payments are 35 points ahead of the work. This needs a follow up before the next payment. The planned completion date is December 15th, 2026. I do not think that date is realistic without the bridge. The ministry letter extends the deadline to March 15th, 2027. If a new work plan arrives within 2 weeks. Next steps, ask the contractor for the revised work plan. Check the road with the 2 more points, and hold the next payment until work on the bridge has started. End of debris.
